content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-404. - I.P.C. Section 605.3, Water service pipe.
content.summary:
Section 605.3. Water service pipe,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
605.3. Water service pipe.
Water service pipe, shall conform to the standards set forth in the Arvada Engineering
                  Standards."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
